stories.title: 49ers run roughshod over Vikings, maintain No. 1 seed in NFC
stories.summary: The 49ers used a late second-quarter burst to take control of Sunday's game in Mexico City and move to 9-1.

stories.title: Red Wings deal star forward Larkin to Canadiens, ending stalemate
stories.summary: Former Detroit Red Wings captain Dylan Larkin was moved to the Montreal Canadiens in a blockbuster deal on Sunday.

stories.title: Frustrated Saleh calls Titans' effort 'disgusting, embarrassing football'
stories.summary: Titans coach Robert Saleh couldn't hide his frustration when he stepped to the podium after Sunday's 51-30 loss to the Cowboys.

stories.title: Big Apple blockbuster: Mets, Skubal reach record 9-year, $450M contract, sources say
stories.summary: Tarik Skubal and the Mets agreed to a nine-year, $450 million contract, sources told ESPN. It is the richest deal for a pitcher, both by total and average annual value.

stories.title: Giants' Skattebo surprises with backflip: 'I have to bring the juice'
stories.summary: Cam Skattebo's pledge to nix his trademark backflip didn't last long. Not even a week.
